statements: SELECT CASE WHEN strpos((SELECT body FROM uqn_fix.source_snapshot WHERE url = $hk$https://www.uqn.gov.sa/decisions-and-regulations/4001669$hk$ LIMIT 1), $hk$يعمل بالتنظيم من تاريخ الموافقة عليه$hk$) > 0 AND strpos((SELECT body FROM uqn_fix.source_snapshot WHERE url = $hk$https://www.uqn.gov.sa/decisions-and-regulations/4001669$hk$ LIMIT 1), $hk$قرار رقم (219) وتاريخ 1448/02/28هـ$hk$) > 0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE id = $hk$b2b20e3951ad444289849b3b07d47afc$hk$ AND name = $hk$تنظيم الهيئة العامة للطرق$hk$ AND strpos(preamble, $hk$قرار رقم (219) وتاريخ 1448/02/28هـ$hk$) = 1) = 1 AND (SELECT id FROM verification WHERE object_type = 'work' AND object_id = $hk$b2b20e3951ad444289849b3b07d47afc$hk$ ORDER BY verified_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) = $hk$boe26-d0f397bae9fdcff26d83ea96$hk$ AND (SELECT verified_status FROM verification WHERE object_type = 'work' AND object_id = $hk$b2b20e3951ad444289849b3b07d47afc$hk$ ORDER BY verified_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) = $hk$ملغى$hk$ AND (SELECT count(*) FROM verification WHERE verified_by = $hk$gap003-roads-status-2026-10-28$hk$) = 0 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END AS guard_before

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, verified_at, supersedes_verification_id) SELECT $hk$vfg3-a439b18c6ead95c0a9bc75c8$hk$, 'work', $hk$b2b20e3951ad444289849b3b07d47afc$hk$, $hk$ساري$hk$, $hk$قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (219) وتاريخ 1448/2/28هـ — من 2026-08-11$hk$, $hk$https://www.uqn.gov.sa/decisions-and-regulations/4001669$hk$, (substr((SELECT body FROM uqn_fix.source_snapshot WHERE url = $hk$https://www.uqn.gov.sa/decisions-and-regulations/4001669$hk$ LIMIT 1), strpos((SELECT body FROM uqn_fix.source_snapshot WHERE url = $hk$https://www.uqn.gov.sa/decisions-and-regulations/4001669$hk$ LIMIT 1), $hk$يعمل بالتنظيم من تاريخ الموافقة عليه$hk$), length($hk$يعمل بالتنظيم من تاريخ الموافقة عليه$hk$)) || $hk$ [منهج HKM-048: السجل هو تنظيم 1448 (ديباجته قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 219 وتاريخ 1448/02/28هـ، المنشور في أم القرى 1448/03/08هـ)؛ حالة «ملغى» السابقة من بطاقة هيئة لتنظيم 1441 (القرار 211 وتاريخ 1441/3/15هـ) لا لهذا السجل؛ النفاذ من تاريخ الموافقة 1448/02/28هـ = 2026-08-11]$hk$), 'rule', $hk$gap003-roads-status-2026-10-28$hk$, now(), $hk$boe26-d0f397bae9fdcff26d83ea96$hk$ WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification WHERE id = $hk$vfg3-a439b18c6ead95c0a9bc75c8$hk$)

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT verified_status FROM verification WHERE object_type = 'work' AND object_id = $hk$b2b20e3951ad444289849b3b07d47afc$hk$ ORDER BY verified_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) = $hk$ساري$hk$ AND (SELECT count(*) FROM verification WHERE verified_by = $hk$gap003-roads-status-2026-10-28$hk$) = 1 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END AS guard_after
